source: Proposal H13 of the 2d-gratnig campaign (R4-B); libraries/grating-mask-search/docs/conditional_mirror_search.txt, its verbatim sections

proposal.title: Frozen-batch conditional mirror search with bounded active windows
proposal.mechanism:
Every candidate is a full 128-row by 256-column row-major binary mask. Score at RCWA(10,5); maximize actual J=(TE+TM)/2, log TE/TM/min separately. Archive completed finite actual binary scores only. One seeded RNG; exact full-mask cache: hits require no new solve but all time charged. Check externally supplied worker deadline at every outer/generation/cache/init/restart loop and before calls; stop with best valid archive or no solution if none, without completing interrupted phases. Individual blocking calls require supervisor timeout. Failure/nonfinite call is charged, not cached/archived, and terminates cleanly. Log requests/cache hits/attempted/completed uncached dual-polarization calls/failures/exposed physical forward work and optimizer counters; backward count zero. Include generation/hash/cache/bookkeeping in full-worker time. No scored seed sharing absent declaration. All rule counts are algorithm specifications, not allocations. All three are custom/unattached; evaluator readiness does not make these custom procedures runnable. Partial initialization always returns best available valid mask at expiry; initial score ties and global archive ties use earliest completed first insertion. No symmetry/fill/min-feature constraints introduced.

Apply common contract verbatim. Start p=0.5 on 8x16 equal tiles; sampled bits fill their tiles. Each batch freezes p_old and draws ONE background BG from independent Bernoulli(p_old); evaluate/archive BG. Select next 16 DISTINCT coordinates from seeded shuffled cyclic permutation, independent of BG; when wrap occurs reshuffle and skip already selected coordinates until 16 distinct chosen (all levels have >=128 variables). For each selected i evaluate BG with bit i inverted; BG's score supplies the other conditional arm. Delta_i=J(BG with i=1)-J(BG with i=0). E[Delta_i|p_old]=dF/dp_i for F(p)=E_product[J]; shared BG correlates estimates, not a variance guarantee. Freeze all p until all 16 opposite-arm scores complete. If interrupted, archive every valid candidate but discard entire incomplete update. On completion, simultaneously set p_i=clip(sigmoid(logit(p_old_i)+0.5*Delta_i),0.05,0.95) for selected coordinates, leaving others unchanged, then evaluate threshold p>=0.5. Batch is completed for stage/reset counters only after this threshold score completes. At most18 evaluation requests per complete batch (BG+16 opposites+threshold), not a measured speedup. After a complete batch update no-new counter: zero if any fresh physical mask evaluated in batch, else increment. If four consecutive no-new batches occur, reset p=0.5 at current grid, reset permutation/local stage count/no-new counter, retaining archive; this reset has precedence over refinement. Otherwise after four completed batches at grid split one axis through 8x16→16x16→16x32→32x32→32x64→64x64→64x128→128x128→128x256, copying parent probabilities and resetting local stage count/permutation/no-new counter. At finest grid continue batches; clear local stage count every four, without refining. Archive and logs remain global. Inheritance preserves threshold geometry, not independent sampling distribution. Many coordinates may be untouched before refinement; log stage reached and visited counts.

Optimizer_v1 package proposes and observes. WORKER owns physical evaluation, immutable exact cache scoped to evaluator identity/fidelity, deadline/timeouts, failure charging and full-worker timing. These duties are dropped from package acceptance. No mandatory package deadline/context/fidelity/evaluator metadata for normal published context. Generic scalar objective mock observations accepted without invented TE/TM; use actual physical metrics when available. Package emits every logical request including duplicates. Worker cache_hits metadata drives fresh-mask/reset accounting; absent cache metadata uses canonical always-solve convention. Preserve exact frozen BG/16 arms/sign/simultaneous update/threshold completion gate/refinement/reset/archive/seeded scientific state. No host changes or direct physical solves. Four real evaluations authorized through independent validation service only. Independent designer derives protected checks.
proposal.rationale: Paired background and opposite-arm scores estimate each selected tile's effect on the expected score under the current probabilities, so a batch moves the probabilities without a surrogate model; grid refinement keeps the coarse geometry it learned.
